notes: Official sentence. This is what makes the chain usable for monster→player hits: monster ATK/accuracy/crit vs player DEF/Toughness/evasion.

name: per_mille_internal_units
expression: %stats are stored ×10 (30% = 300); multiplier = (1000 + value) / 1000; '100% + 받는 피해 감소%' is computed as 1000 + 300

name: toughness_stacking
expression: actualGain = (100% − current) × added / 100%; total capped at 95% (StatTypeTable maxValueE3 950)
notes: IL2CPP ChainedPercentageAccumCalculator; tooltip: 'After Defense reduces incoming damage, Damage Taken Decrease reduces it further'. Order confirmed: DEF step first, then Toughness.

name: defense_penetration_stacking
expression: actualGain = (100% − current) × added / 100%; cap 100% (display max 99.9%)

name: evasion
expression: gap = max(target Evasion − attacker Accuracy, 0); miss chance = StatGapValueTable[gap]; 70% at gap ≥ 100
applies_to: player evading monster hits and vice versa
notes: Full 100-row table in stat_gap_table.json. Monster HitChance per growth-dungeon monster is in growth_dungeon_monsters.json.

name: critical_resistance
expression: effective crit rate = clamp(attacker crit − target 크리티컬 저항, 0, 100%); negative resist raises attacker crit
notes: Same rule in wiki Character Stats. Monster crit stats are not published (unknown whether monsters crit).

name: final_damage_stacking
expression: combined = Π(1 + FD_i) − 1

name: min_max_clamp
expression: each strike rolls between Min and Max multiplier; if Min > Max, Max is used

name: guild_war_excess_accuracy
expression: Guild War only: FD += min(max(Acc − target Eva, 0), 30) × 0.5%  (max +15%)
notes: Official 2/12 patch note: 내 명중이 상대 회피보다 높을수록 최종 데미지 소폭 증가, 최대 30 차이.

name: constants_5000_6000_for_monster_to_player
expression: 5,000 ÷ (6,000 + DEF×(1−pierce)) with DEF = defender's DEF
notes: Officially stated for PvP where the defender is a player (so player DEF does enter 5000/(6000+DEF)). For monster→player in PvE the official text only says the base chain uses attacker offense and target defense; no official PvE example and no published measurement exists. Monster attacks in co-op content add a target-Max-HP term (A×a% + H×h%) BEFORE the chain (see exceptions). Status: consistent but NOT measured; do not treat as proven.

name: pvp_sqrt

name: pvp_adjustment_old
expression: × [아레나 10,000 / 콜로세움 6,000] × 최대 HP[target] ÷ √(공격력×관통×데미지×증폭×((기공+스뎀)/2)×스탯비례×(크뎀×크확 비중)×((최소+최대)/2)×최종뎀) ÷ 1,000,000
notes: Bug: damage rose with target Max HP; replaced 7/2.

name: pvp_adjustment_new
expression: × C ÷ (((ATK×pierce×dmg×amp×((basic+skill)/2)×statprop×(critdmg×critweight)×((min+max)/2)×FD + 1e9)^0.23 × (MaxHP×1e8)^0.12 × ((DEF+6000)×1e12)^0.14 × ((1000+Toughness)×1e6)^0.5) ÷ 1e7) ÷ 1e6
notes: C = Arena 7,206,000,000 / Colosseum 4,323,600,000 / World Arena 5,764,800,000. Both offensive and defensive inputs of this adjustment use the TARGET's pre-battle stats (no active skills/buffs).
